convention: docs/composition-corpus/README.md (a) EMPTY — structural, never pixels; AMENDED 2026-08-08 by docs/research/layout-grammar-proposal.md G8.5. On an axis the contract declares INTRINSIC, the resulting geometry is scored on the FILLED surface, where content exists to measure. The EMPTY score keeps presence, name and the cell RECT (anchor + span) — contract facts, surface-independent — and does NOT compare the hugged axis's pixel height, which is each surface's own convention for "there is nothing here": measured here, an empty auto-layout SLOT keeps Figma's minimum (100px) while CSS gives 0 plus any row gaps (grid-gallery: 16). Making them agree would mean the emitter resizing empty slots to zero to satisfy a scorer, which is refused.
